title: GTA III: Alternate Timelines
subtitle: One quiet driver, three families, and a city that mistakes silence for weakness.

achievements.title: Ghost Courier
achievements.description: Control Liberty while barely speaking a word.

achievements.title: Family Broker
achievements.description: Keep all families profitable for one night.

achievements.title: Bridge Burner
achievements.description: Start a citywide war and survive it.

achievements.title: Quiet Exit
achievements.description: Leave Liberty with clean papers and dirty memories.

arrival.title: Arrival in Rain
text: A prison convoy gets interrupted by masked men and louder intentions. You are extracted, handed a pager, and informed your new career path has excellent growth opportunities and no dental plan.
Liberty is steel, rain, and resentment. Every alley has cameras, every camera has blind spots, and every blind spot has a business model.
Your handler says one sentence: work hard, ask nothing, and never trust a man with a family crest on his ring.

choices.label: Run courier jobs for the old family
Take side work from uptown crews

docks_pickup.title: Docks Pickup
text: You collect a van full of electronics and one man who insists he is not nervous while chain-smoking his way through half the Atlantic.
Port unions, smugglers, and dock security all want a cut. Nobody agrees on percentages, but everyone agrees on ammunition.
The old family praises your efficiency in the tone of people evaluating furniture: useful, replaceable, and probably expensive.

choices.label: Deliver clean and build old-family trust
Skim cargo and build your own stash

uptown_signal.title: Uptown Signal
text: A rooftop meet turns into a dancehall summit where everyone smiles until the bass drops and negotiations become ballistic.
You keep the package moving through traffic that seems personally offended by your existence.
By dawn you have new contacts, a better gun, and six new reasons to distrust everybody with a startup mentality.

choices.label: Sell uptown intel to the old family

safehouse_ledger.title: Safehouse Ledger
text: You turn a condemned apartment into an operations room with radios, city maps, and takeout menus annotated like military doctrine.
A fixer explains Liberty economics: never own the violence, only invoice it.
You can play mediator, arsonist, or accountant with body armor.

choices.label: Seed conflict and profit from chaos

council_dinner.title: Council Dinner
text: Three factions meet in a private club with velvet chairs, armed waiters, and a wine list that could fund a small insurgency.
You are asked to guarantee deliveries, settle debts, and decide which liar gets promoted.
The room calls this diplomacy. The morgue calls it preproduction.

choices.label: Back the old family and centralize control
Balance all sides for a broker empire

bridge_lockdown.title: Bridge Lockdown
text: A downtown bombing closes the bridges. The city fragments into armed islands with toll booths.
Your pager will not stop buzzing. Every district wants extraction, ammo, and miracles by sunset.
You can hold lines and negotiate routes, or torch everything and own the aftermath.

choices.label: Organize protected convoys and tax movement
Trigger full war and wipe rivals

final_night.title: Final Nightshift
text: Under neon rain and police sirens, your empire either coheres or combusts.
All old debts come due at once. Family bosses call you son, traitor, and savior in the same voicemail.
By sunrise Liberty will have one logistics king, one uneasy coalition, or one large cautionary tale.

choices.label: Take command and run Liberty like a private utility
Hold the coalition and profit quietly
Burn every bridge and rule the ashes

ending_ghost_courier.title: Ghost Courier
text: You become the most feared name in city logistics: no speeches, no interviews, just perfect deliveries and terrible consequences.
Liberty runs because your schedule says it does.

ending.title: Ghost Courier
ending.summary: You take total control of Liberty's criminal supply lines.

ending_family_broker.title: Family Broker
text: You keep all factions rich enough to behave and poor enough to need you.
Nobody loves you, which in this city is the closest thing to peace.

ending.title: Family Broker
ending.summary: You build a profitable balance between rival syndicates.

ending_bridge_burner.title: Bridge Burner
text: You win the war and lose the city. Districts burn, rivals die, and every bridge becomes a checkpoint with your initials on it.
The newspapers call it a tragedy. Your crew calls it market consolidation.

ending.title: Bridge Burner
ending.summary: You survive a citywide war and rule a battered Liberty.

ending_quiet_exit.title: Quiet Exit
text: You leave Liberty at dawn with forged documents, clean shoes, and absolutely no intention of answering unknown numbers ever again.
The city keeps moving, offended that you escaped politely.

ending.title: Quiet Exit
ending.summary: You walk away before the final war consumes everyone.
